resources.string: No answer? Continues with the recommended option in %1$s.
When enabled, agent questions automatically continue with the recommended option after 5 minutes without an answer. When disabled, current and future questions wait for your response.
Let unanswered agent questions continue with the recommended option after 5 minutes
Show the agent\'s task list above the message box in Code. When off, the list stays hidden and the agent keeps working the same way.
Show or hide the agent\'s to-do list in Code
When off, nothing can start a subagent: not the agent, a plugin or another setting. Running subagents stop. Only you can turn this back on.
Subagents are off. The options below have no effect until you turn them back on.
Turn every subagent off so nothing can start one
